held.noAdjust: Your role may not adjust stock.
held.pickOne: Select one row (or press a on a row): Adjust works on one stock row at a time.
held.severalHides: This row holds several hides: adjust one hide (Rows ▾ Leather, or the Hides page).
held.pastDate: Stock as of a past date cannot be changed.

st.search: Search or scan a material, lot, hide or place

tile.crvi: Lots waiting for the Cr VI result

st.onHandLink: Open the moves behind this figure

empty.title: No stock yet
empty.body: Stock comes in with receipts against purchase orders, or with the opening stock sheet.

notice.crViFailed_one: {count} lot failed its Cr VI test: it can never be issued and waits to be rejected.
notice.crViFailed_other: {count} lots failed their Cr VI test: they can never be issued and wait to be rejected.
notice.crVi_one: {count} lot waits for its Cr VI result: its stock cannot be issued.
notice.crVi_other: {count} lots wait for a Cr VI result: their stock cannot be issued.
notice.quarantine_one: {count} lot is in quarantine and waits for quality’s release.
notice.quarantine_other: {count} lots are in quarantine and wait for quality’s release.
notice.truncated: Too many rows for one answer: pick a site or a view to see them all.
notice.unvalued_one: {count} move is not valued yet: the values here leave it out.
notice.unvalued_other: {count} moves are not valued yet: the values here leave them out.
notice.overReserved_one: {count} material has more reserved than there is: release or move a reservation.
notice.overReserved_other: {count} materials have more reserved than there is: release or move a reservation.

st.overReserved: over-reserved: more is reserved than is here
st.valued: Valued stock list as of {day} (PDF, opens a new tab)

asOf.paused: live updates off for a past date
asOf.noticeBody: Nothing can be changed here. Held, reserved and available are not kept for past days, so they show —.

adj.title: Adjust stock
adj.intro: {site} · {place}: {quantity} {unit} on hand now. The stock changes only through this move, with its reason.
adj.locationHint: An increase can land in another place of the site.
adj.noteHint: Kept with the move for good: say what happened.
adj.referenceHint: A count sheet, a claim or a DDT number (optional).
adj.unitCostHint: Left empty: the lot’s cost, else the standard cost.

preview.none: Type the quantity to see the change.

held.unitCost: Type the cost as a number (up to 6 decimals).

problem.notEnough: That stock is not there any more (someone used it meanwhile): stock never goes below zero. Close and read the figures again.
problem.changed: It changed meanwhile. Close and try again.
problem.invalid: Something was not accepted: check the quantity, the unit and the reason.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not adjust stock here.
problem.offline: No connection: nothing was posted. Try again when the network is back.
problem.gone: That stock or place no longer exists.
problem.write: It was not posted. Try again.

mv.countLoaded_one: {count} move loaded · more as you scroll
mv.countLoaded_other: {count} moves loaded · more as you scroll

tileHint.unvalued: their value is missing from the totals

mv.clocks: Happened {device} (the tablet’s clock for a floor move) · recorded {server}
mv.keyReverse: Reverse the focused move (its detail first)
mv.oneAtATime: A reversal is one deliberate act: open a move to reverse it.

held.noKey: Open Movements from a stock figure (a material at a site) to adjust it here.

empty.title: No moves yet
empty.body: Every receipt, issue, return, transfer, count and correction lands here, never edited.

notice.moreFailed: The next rows couldn't be read. Scroll again to retry.
notice.moreOffline: No connection: the next rows wait for the network.
notice.adjustSeveral_one: This stock lies in {count} place: adjust it from Stock, one row at a time.
notice.adjustSeveral_other: This stock lies in {count} places (or several hides): adjust it from Stock, one row at a time.
notice.adjustNone: Nothing of this stock is on hand: adjust from a place in Stock.
notice.adjustFailed: The stock to adjust couldn't be read. Try again.
notice.writeOffNone: Nothing of this stock is on hand: there is nothing to write off.
notice.writeOffHides_one: This leather is {count} hide: write it off from Hides › Scrap.
notice.writeOffHides_other: This leather is {count} hides: scrap them from Hides (select them, Scrap…), or open Movements from one hide.
notice.writeOffSeveral_one: This stock lies in {count} place: write it off from Stock, one row at a time.
notice.writeOffSeveral_other: This stock lies in {count} places: open Movements from one place (a stock row) to write it off.
notice.writeOffFailed: The stock to write off couldn't be read. Try again.

why.title: Why is it this number
why.addsUp: Adds up to the stock figure: {quantity} {unit} ✓
why.gap: Does not add up by {gap} {unit}: that is a fault, not your mistake. Tell the administrator.
why.formula: Receipts + returns − issues − scrap ± adjustments ± counts; transfers inside the site net 0. Press a reason to see its moves.

detail.title: {reason} · {material}
detail.first: This is the first loaded move.
detail.last: This is the last loaded move.
detail.keys: J / K previous and next · r reverse · Esc closes
detail.stationOnly: This site records the station only: no worker is named.
detail.notValued: Not valued (a transfer, no cost basis, or a floor move not valued yet).

mv.search: Search the ledger: material, lot, hide, place, document, note
mv.countOf_one: {loaded} of {count} move loaded · more as you scroll
mv.countOf_other: {loaded} of {count} moves loaded · more as you scroll

rev.title: Reverse this move
rev.intro: The reversal is a new move, the mirror of this one: the same quantity, from and to swapped. The original stays in the ledger, struck through and linked.
rev.reach: The stock goes back to where it was before this move. It is refused when later moves already used that stock.
rev.noteHint: Kept with the reversal for good.

held.long: The reason is longer than 500 characters.

problem.used: Stock already used by later moves: this move cannot be reversed now. Reverse the later moves first, or adjust.
problem.notNow: This move cannot be reversed from the ledger (an issue or a return from its pick list, a receipt with its receipt).
problem.changed: It changed meanwhile (perhaps already reversed). Close and read it again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not reverse moves.
problem.offline: No connection: nothing was posted. Try again when the network is back.
problem.gone: This move no longer exists, or belongs to another company.
problem.invalid: The reason was not accepted (1 to 500 characters).
problem.write: It was not posted. Try again.
